intro.text: Elend Venture's mother, a noblewoman of Luthadel whom he speaks of only in the past tense.

items.text: She had a deep influence on Elend, who resembled her far more than he resembled his father, Straff.

Elend told Vin that his mother liked to say that waiting on a lady's whims is good for a gentleman. When Vin remarked that she sounded wise, Elend answered that she had not been wise enough to avoid marrying Straff.
